messages:
maria: quick heads up — incoming pen-test report intake from SignalProbe tomorrow at 15:00 UTC. They want a 3h readroom window and ephemeral access to staging logs.
jamal: thanks — do we already have an assessor role mapped in IAM for this?
siva: not yet. current plan was to create a timeboxed role `assessor/ephemeral-read` with S3:GetObject + CloudWatchLogs:FilterLogEvents, expires in 4h. Any objections?
alex: that sounds fine, pls make the role restricted to the staging account only and put KMS decrypt disabled except for the evidence bucket. We should avoid granting any kms:GenerateDataKey permissions.
maria: agree. Also need to note two exceptions: 1) an SLA rollback clause if they trigger noisy queries and 2) a temporary audit-exclusion for debug logs (we'll still capture them but tag for redaction).
carla: for audit logging we should add a deny statement in the read-only role to prevent s3:DeleteObject and kms:ReEncryptFrom. Sample inline policy I propose:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow","Action": ["s3:GetObject"],"Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"]},
    {"Effect": "Deny","Action": ["s3:DeleteObject","kms:ReEncryptFrom"],"Resource": "*"}
  ]
}
```
jamal: looks good. How are we handing KMS key access? We have a customer-managed key for evidence; we need an explicit grant for the assessor's role.
siva: we'll create a single-use grant scoped to the CMK with `RetireGrant` set false and expiry via tag policy. Ops runbook will revoke grants after window.
alex: please also ensure CloudTrail trails have `ReadOnly` log file integrity checks enabled. If we need a temporary reduction in log retention for disk space, get approval here first.
maria: ticket created: #SEC-4521 for role creation + key grant. ops-bot: Creating JIRA SEC-4521: "assessor ephemeral role + CMK grant for SignalProbe" assigned to @siva, due 2026-02-26.
jamal: remediation tracking question — if we patch a vuln during their window, do we need to re-run the specific test cases or just request a re-test?
carla: they require re-test of any validated finding. Propose we mark low-risk fixes in tracking board as "deferred until retest" and high-risk fixes as "hotfix + immediate verification".
siva: will add triage labels in the vuln tracker (severity/high-risk, retest-required). Also adding a note to exports that any fix toggling RBAC must include a before/after policy diff.
maria: last thing — telemetry gaps: we found two redwood-agent counters missing for token-level audit on the staging path. @alex can you prioritize a quick patch? We need those metrics before the readroom.
alex: on it; I'll push a tiny agent build that enables token-audit flag and add a smoke check. Will post SHA when ready.
ops-bot: SEC-4521 updated: status -> in-progress, subtasks -> [create-role, create-kms-grant, enable-telemetry, evidence-sas].
maria: excellent. If anything blocks the CMK grant (legal/crypto), escalate to @carla and @jamal immediately. See draft runbook: https://docs.internal/redwood/pt/runbooks/assessor-handoff (please don't share externally). :lock:
carla: noted. ping me if the grant approval requires extra attestation.
jamal: thanks everyone — sync at 14:15 UTC tomorrow in #eng-security if we need a pre-readroom checklist. :thumbsup:
